name: What is the difference between latex and oil-based paint for interiors?

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between latex and oil-based paint for interiors?

acceptedAnswer.text: Latex (water-based) paints are generally easier to clean up, dry faster, and are more flexible, making them resistant to cracking. They are also lower in VOCs, offering less odor. Oil-based paints are known for their durability and hard, smooth finish, making them suitable for trim, doors, and cabinets. However, they have a stronger odor and longer drying times. We can recommend the best type for your specific project.
acceptedAnswer.description: Latex paints are easy to clean, quick-drying, and flexible; oil-based paints offer durability and a hard finish but have stronger odors.
